code.note: 95d731b builds the index tables and card pictures from the published meta.json files. The maps themselves are from the first release of 27 October 2026; each surface's meta.json records its render SHA-256 and every model's weights.

caveats: No ground truth: there are no ink labels here, so nothing in this dataset scores a model.
Not a reading: ink maps are model output; nothing here says that letters were found or read.
A screened subset: the 25 First Letters surfaces are those a fixed rule let out, not a random sample of each scroll.
Training exposure is unknown for most model pairs; most models do not publish their full training lists.
One render per surface: a different trace of the same sheet can change every map.

truth.what: seven models' maps, both depth orders and three windows
truth.note: a later read of them with these models is not blind
